ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a minor distribution (<5%) of high-intensity (white) punctate clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark surface covering >90% of the visible area. Contiguous high-contrast white punctate spots are concentrated on the medial and distal portions of the right lobe, particularly near the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a narrow vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire visible trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits specific deep, irregular pixel-valleys (notches) between sharp jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a convex outer curve transitioning to a straight trailing edge. The right lobe shows a sharply concave/curled trajectory due to perspective and edge-tearing.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups located along the distal margins and posterior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and traumatic jaggedness on the trailing edge of the right lobe, exceeding standard biological serration patterns.
